description: Ground truth for evaluating ARVE. Every positive finding was planted deliberately; every negative control must produce no finding.

scanners.codeql: not run: CodeQL has no PHP extractor

engine_expectations_note: CodeQL does not support PHP. The correct ARVE outcome for this repository is a COMPLETED scan with the CodeQL engine reported as skipped: not PARTIAL, not FAILED.

findings.notes: $db->query() on a string literal concatenated with a LIKE pattern built from $_GET['q'].
shell_exec on a literal concatenated with the unvalidated ?format= value.
eval() on the posted settings bundle.
file_get_contents on a literal directory concatenated with ?name=. The plan's $dir prefix became a string literal because the rule needs one.
Download-link JWT signing key hardcoded in the config array and passed to JWT::encode in src/token.php.
RSA private key generated with openssl.
Deploy token in a workflow env block. Deliberately not a provider-prefixed token (ghp_ etc.), to stay clear of GitHub push protection.

SMTP relay token in a file that is added and then deleted two commits later. Only a git-history scan finds it. Built by scripts/seed_history.py, which derives the value from a seed so it never appears at HEAD.

notes: CodeQL does not support PHP, so engine_expectations.codeql is "skipped" and no entry expects it. ARVE must finish the scan as COMPLETED with CodeQL skipped: not PARTIAL, not FAILED.
SEC-04 is deliberately unused. IDs are aligned with the Python and JS testbeds, where SEC-05 is the history-only secret and SEC-06 the runbook webhook; the PHP matrix has one HEAD secret fewer.

Known ARVE false positive (Semgrep): arve.php.command-injection and arve.php.path-traversal match the syntactic shape f("..." . $X) for any $X, so shell_exec("cmd " . escapeshellarg($x)) and file_get_contents("dir/" . basename($x)) are reported. SAFE-02 and SAFE-03 bind the argument to a variable first; no control asserts the false positive.

ARVE rulepack gap (PHP): the same rules need a string literal as the left operand of a single concatenation. A three-part concatenation ("a" . $x . "b"), a constant or __DIR__ prefix, or a command built in a variable is not matched. The SAST plants use the exact two-operand shape.

composer.lock was generated with `composer update --no-install --no-security-blocking`: Composer 2.9+ refuses to resolve versions with known advisories by default. Transitive packages resolve to current, advisory-free versions.
expected_counts_note: Working-tree counts, not plant counts: the 4 DEP plants yield 32 OSV records. gitleaks_history = the 4 HEAD secrets, each reported at the commit that added it, plus SEC-05.
